title: 2017 revelations of OSAP UFO study groups
summary: Jesse Michels tells of 2017 revelations of OSAP UFO study groups, about 2017 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: It's interesting in 2017 you had, you know, revelations around their the existence of UFO study groups and stuff, at OSAP, that sort of thing.

plain: Talking with a Navy scientist who holds unusual patents, the podcast host Jesse Michels recalls that in 2017 it came out that the US government had groups studying UFOs. He links these groups to something he calls OSAP, which he presents as a government body behind that work, and gives no more detail. He brings it up as the moment official UFO research first became public.
